label: Whatever is PERFECT_1 in a respect is desirable in that respect
paraphrase: Forward half of 'each thing is desirable insofar as it is perfect', analyst weak version: for every bearer x and perfection p, if x is perfect in p (PERFECT_1) then x is desirable in p. Aquinas' stated reason in ST I q.5 a.1 co. (omnia appetunt suam perfectionem) bears on this half (see the Lean doc of DesirableInsofarAsPerfectReading); no new source claim is made.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: The q.5 argument a5a50fe3 needs the biconditional (comparison conjunct 6: it is exactly this forward half together with the backward half). A route using the forward half alone would need either the backward half from another argument, or a q.5 conclusion weakened to 'whatever actually has a perfection is GOOD_1 in it' with its own downstream consumer.
connection_plan.blocker: No downstream consumer of the one-directional goodness conclusion exists, and the backward half has no argument.
